entities.name: 5GSM status procedure
entities.description: A 5G session management procedure used to report error conditions or status information between the UE and network.

entities.name: 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: A 5GSM message used to convey status information or error conditions during 5G session management procedures.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: An information element that indicates the specific cause or reason for a 5GSM status message.

relations.description: The 5GSM status procedure involves sending or receiving the 5GSM STATUS message.
The 5GSM STATUS message contains the 5GSM cause information element to indicate the specific error or status condition.
